I couldn't find a night-dispatch contact for Driftmoor Marine Freight in what I can see. The only related note is from November 2025: Driftmoor requested a patched manifest CSV before the 06:00 shift. That note doesn't name a contact.

The "Hector" night dispatcher I found is at Pellucid Harbor Logistics, not Driftmoor, so I'd avoid using him for this. Kwame is the best person to ask, since he's the account manager on the port work. If you want, I can post a short question to Kwame in #coastal-team, or send him a DM asking for the Driftmoor contact.
